author: burmanharry
description: Find US BJJ gyms, drop-ins, and class times.
name: OpenMapp

tools.name: find_gyms
tools.title: Find BJJ gyms
tools.description: Find BJJ gyms near a US city, neighborhood, or ZIP. Defaults: open to drop-ins, classes today. Returns drop-in policy, visitor fee when known, matching class times, and online booking (reservePrice, reserveUrl) when the gym takes reservations.

q.description: City, neighborhood, address, or ZIP, same as the OpenMapp search box

drop_ins.description: Only gyms marked Drop-ins (known welcome or a listed visitor/open-mat price). Default true

today.description: Only gyms with a listed class or open mat today. Default true

kinds.description: Filter to Gi, No-Gi, and/or open mat

day.description: Restrict to this weekday or tomorrow. Overrides today

tools.name: get_gym
tools.title: Get gym details
tools.description: Full public gym card: address, drop-in policy, visitor fee, the weekly timetable, and online booking when the gym takes reservations (price and reserveUrl per class). Use an id or slug from find_gyms.

id.description: Gym id or slug from find_gyms, e.g. 10th-planet-allentown

tools.name: start_reservation
tools.title: Start a drop-in reservation
tools.description: Check that a class at a gym can be reserved online right now and get the link where the visitor signs the gym's waiver and pays (or reserves free). Returns the class's next date and start time, price, cancellation policy, and reserveUrl. It does not book anything: the visitor must open reserveUrl and sign and pay themselves. When status is unavailable, reason says why and reservableClasses lists classes that can be reserved instead.

id.description: Gym id or slug from find_gyms or get_gym

day.description: Weekday of the class, as listed in sessions

time.description: Class start time as listed in sessions, e.g. "6:30 PM"

name.description: Class name from sessions. Needed only when the gym lists two classes at the same day and time

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD within the next 7 days, on the class's weekday. Default: the next time the class runs

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: List covered cities
tools.description: US cities OpenMapp covers, with gym counts, how many welcome class drop-ins, and how many list an open mat. Use this to check coverage before find_gyms. Filter by city name or two-letter state.

q.description: Filter by city name, e.g. Austin

limit.description: Max cities to return. Default all matching, max 500

tools.name: map_url
tools.title: OpenMapp map link
tools.description: OpenMapp map link for a city search, optionally with a gym drawer already open.

q.description: City or search text for the map search box

gym_id.description: Gym id from find_gyms to open the details drawer
